dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh, hey kiddo!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Now here I was thinking that the Lantern Rite would go by without incident this year. But my, did I not expect to see the Jade Chamber to rise again in my time.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: It's a good way to start the year, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How have things been going lately?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Well, after handing my work off to others, I must say that I've certainly freed up a lot of time.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: And now that I've had time to handle more mundane matters, I've realized that many of my old fishing buddies have either passed, or that we've drifted apart in the intervening years.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...Seems like you've got a lot on your mind, too. So how about it, wanna reel a few fish in together?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: You've got to get away from the clutter if you want to keep your mind clear. In many things, you just have to go with the flow. As long as your conscience is clear, things will be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Wow. I didn't think you'd be able to break the game this way.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: This is a game I've been thinking about for a long time. It's not easy to break, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Well, if I were younger, I might have figured out a way to break it...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate an old veteran's card skills...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Just a spot of fishing. I don't make my living off of it anymore, though, so when I catch something, I throw it right back in again.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: It's been a long time since I chatted with someone your age. Good to meet you. Here, have a fish.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fishing...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Fishing, you say... Well, it's certainly not a tool to hide my identity. I really do enjoy fishing.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: After a life of struggle and strife, fishing is how I quiet down and clear my thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: To be honest, I'm not even all that concerned about the value of my catches anymore... On the other hand, you seem quite concerned about that, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Haha, come now, of course I can see it. Here, you can take today's catch.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Darn. Seems I forgot my bait.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh, hey kiddo!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Hey there! Never expected any young 'uns would come talking to me at my age.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Find yourself a spot to sit. You can call me Uncle Tian. Makes this old codger feel like a young man again.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Huh? You think I still look young?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Well, youth isn't really a matter of age... it's more to do with how much pain and suffering you've experienced in your life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about your boat.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: This boat? You like her huh? Been with me all my life...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Back when I was a young fella, I was poorer than a panhandler, but at least I had it in me to haul in whatever snagged my line!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Things you do for yourself, you yourself get to reap the rewards for. How much you sweat determines how much you get... Those were the good ole days, could just keep goin' an' never get tired.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Ahhh, what was I saying... Lost my train of thought...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh, right. Anyway, I struggled for the first... I dunno how long, but with perseverance and bit of luck, I got my own business started up and didn't have to do all the fishin' myself anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: But, everyone's out tryna swindle each other, an' before I knew it, I'd lost sight of myself.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: So to bring myself back to my roots, I bring my tired old self here to fish and talk about the good ole days.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Back when I was a young fella, I was poorer than a panhandler...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You ahh... said that part already...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...Whaddya mean I said that already? Don't butt in when the old fella's talkin'. Now back then I was poorer than a panhandler...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: but at least I had it in me to haul 'em in...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Okay, great. Ahh... Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh, alright then. Be careful out there young 'un.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: If you happen to pass by Qingce Village and see my dear Yundan, be sure to speak with her, let her know I'm alive, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Ho there, youngster.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Oh? So it's you. Haha, I suppose there's no point keeping up the act, then.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about your real identity...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Shh... Don't shout it for the whole world to hear. Other than a few people in key posts, the number of people who know my identity can be counted on one hand.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: People have ever been made to choose between status and freedom.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: It has taken a lot of effort for me to preserve both, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: But I, too, shall give up my seat as one of the Qixing someday. The more freedom I experience, the more status feels unwieldy and clumsy.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...I hope that "he" too can enjoy his freedom, now that he has thrown off his yoke.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Huixin...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Haha, thanks for looking out for my daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: She can be quite headstrong. Only good old Ganyu... I mean, Ms. Ganyu, can get through to her.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: But ever since that previous incident, she seems to have become more receptive to my advice...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...Speaking of which, you're quite the cunning player yourself, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Till next time.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Go well, youngster.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: If you happen to pass by Qingce Village and see my dear Yundan, be sure to speak with her, let her know I'm alive, yeah?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: What's all this commotion... Has something happened?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's the Lantern Rite festival.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...Oh yes, Lantern Rite! One of the biggest days of the year.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Young people these days... I do wonder whether they will be able to cope...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A dragon, Stoneterror, is attacking the city!

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: ...A dragon, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Well don't just stand there, call the Milibands! ...The Band of Mili-Men, you know? Or was it the Mili-Band of Brothers? The Knights that Mill Around, maybe?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: *sigh* I can't remember what they're called. I'll probably just fish here a while longer then go back home...
